access.clients.chatbox.step1: In Chatbox, open Settings, go to the model provider and choose OpenAI API compatible.
access.clients.chatbox.step2: Enter the base URL and key. If the app adds /v1 itself, remove /v1 from the end of the URL.
access.clients.chatbox.step3: Add or pick a model name, then send a message to test it.
access.clients.cherry-studio.step1: In Cherry Studio, open Settings, then Model providers, and add a provider of type OpenAI.
access.clients.cherry-studio.step2: Enter the base URL and key.
access.clients.cherry-studio.step3: Add the model name below, enable it and start chatting.
access.clients.claude-code.step1: Set these environment variables in the terminal that runs Claude Code.
access.clients.claude-code.step2: Then run claude. It uses the Anthropic-style API, so it takes the Anthropic-compatible base URL above.
access.clients.curl.step1: Set the environment variable API_KEY to your key, then run it in a terminal.
access.clients.keyNote: Replace $API_KEY in the examples with your own key. This page never shows or stores a key.
access.clients.lanHint: You opened the console on this machine. Replace <LAN-IP> with the LAN address of this machine.
access.clients.modelHint: Use auto to let the platform choose, or type a model name.
access.clients.opencode.step1: Save the configuration below as opencode.json in your project.
access.clients.opencode.step2: Set the environment variable API_KEY to your key, then start OpenCode and choose Local AI.
access.clients.openwebui.step1: In Open WebUI, open Admin Settings and go to Connections.
access.clients.openwebui.step2: Add an OpenAI connection and enter the base URL and your key below.
access.clients.openwebui.step3: Save it and the platform's models appear in the model list. You can also use the environment variables below.
access.clients.publicMissing: No public base URL is set, so Public is unavailable. Set one under Public access.
access.clients.python.step1: Install the openai library: pip install openai.
access.clients.python.step2: Set the environment variable API_KEY to your key, then run the code below.
access.clients.subtitle: Copy the settings to connect common apps to this platform. No real key appears on this page.

access.field.allowedIps.help: Optional. Only accept requests from these addresses or ranges; empty means any.

access.field.dailyRequests.help: Total requests per day; resets at midnight. Empty means no cap.
access.field.dailyRequests.label: Requests per day
access.field.dailyTokens.help: Total tokens per day; resets at midnight. Empty means no cap.
access.field.dailyTokens.label: Tokens per day
access.field.expires.help: The key stops working at the end of this day. Empty means it never expires.

access.field.fleetAllow.help: Optional. Only route to matching deployments, for example vllm:*; empty means any.

access.field.maxConcurrent.help: How many requests run at the same time; the rest queue.
access.field.maxConcurrent.label: Concurrent requests
access.field.maxOutputTokens.help: The most tokens one request may generate; longer answers are cut.
access.field.maxOutputTokens.label: Output tokens per request
access.field.maxQueued.help: How many requests may wait in line; beyond it the API answers 429. 0 means no queue.
access.field.maxQueued.label: Queue length
access.field.models.help: Which models the key may call. * is a wildcard and a leading ! excludes; empty means no model.
access.field.models.label: Models
access.field.monthlyTokens.help: Total tokens per month; resets at the start of the month. Empty means no cap.
access.field.monthlyTokens.label: Tokens per month
access.field.name.help: A name you can recognise. You type it back to revoke the key.
access.field.name.label: Name
access.field.notes.label: Notes
access.field.queueTimeoutSeconds.help: How long a request may wait in line before it fails with 503.
access.field.queueTimeoutSeconds.label: Queue timeout
access.field.requestTimeoutSeconds.help: The longest a single request may run before it is cut off.
access.field.requestTimeoutSeconds.label: Request timeout
access.field.rpm.help: Maximum requests per minute. Beyond it the API returns 429; clients should wait for Retry-After.
access.field.rpm.label: Requests per minute
access.field.scopes.help: Tick the APIs this key may call. Anything unticked answers 403.
access.field.scopes.label: What the key may do
access.field.tpm.help: Maximum tokens (input plus output) per minute. Beyond it the API returns 429.
access.field.tpm.label: Tokens per minute
